_doc: National traits (docs/NATIONS.md). Each country has 1 to 3. `traits`: definitions; effects are small, signed numbers: tax (tax efficiency, +0.02 = 2 points), stability and legitimacy (points added to their targets), influence (diplomatic influence per month), and shares for manpower, construction (negative = cheaper), research, combat (land, sea and air), naval (naval combat), trade (share of the monthly export value earned as revenue), industry, farm, growth (population growth), movement and siege. `tags`: traits by country tag; TAG@scenario wins over TAG (tags mean different countries in different scenarios). Countries not listed get `defaultCount` traits from the first `defaults` rules that match their capital's region, era and situation; the pick inside a rule is fixed by the tag, so it is the same in every game.
